name: samky-studio
description: SAMKY Studio — approachable local/online event simulation built on MiroFish

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
scripts.doctor: cd backend && uv run python scripts/sam_cli.py doctor
scripts.headless: cd backend && uv run python scripts/sam_cli.py
